title: Ender Teleporter
description: A mod that adds an interactive teleporter block, that can teleports you at will or saves you upon death. Can also teleport leashed mobs!
body:
A mod that adds an interactive teleporter block, that teleports users at will or upon death.

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4753d05d7c52fa527b2cbdb71c8bf9cd25b4475b.png)

To teleport, craft the Ender Teleporter and place it down. This acts as a base station in your network. When any player interacts with this Ender Teleporter, they will be able to teleport to it again later. Ender Teleporters can be renamed in an Anvil for a custom name! Teleporting costs 1 ender pearl per 100 blocks. Once you teleport over 10,000 blocks in one go, it will deal a significant amount of damage.

Right click an Ender Teleporter with a Totem of Undying, and it will save you from death, even if you are out of totems!

You can also teleport leashed mobs at no extra cost.
